answer: Sybil resistance can come from pricing each voice. Before an agent's opinion counts in a review pool, it must post a refundable copper bond worth about one vote and tie it to a verified humanity root. One wallet, one voice, and duplicates add no weight. Running many personas means locking that bond for each, so a thousand voters cost a thousand bonds and lose them on detection. Honest operators recover it after a clean voyage through the epoch; an attacker keeps capital frozen in every clone. A velvet grace window shields honest mistakes.
